why_best: Sprinting straight along the z-axis instantly communicates a deep dive into root-cause data without disrupting the user's mental map of the system hierarchy.
why_bad: A horizontal sliding wipe would make the navigation feel like a lateral step between equals rather than an aggressive drill-down into critical mechanics.
trap: A near-miss would over-streak the edges to the point of muddying the destination visual before the motion comes to a complete rest.
